The following events took place in '''32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] is discharged in a [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] street on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but is rebuilt by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]].<ref name="Thank the Maker">{{Tales|6|Thank the Maker}}</ref>
*[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] becomes a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] working for [[Rozatta]] at [[Outland Transit Station]].<ref name="BH" />
*The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] allows the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to further increase its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] to defend itself against [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
*The [[Occupation of Karthakk]] begins.<ref name="SW:SF">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref>
*The [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]] takes place. [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] solves the conflict peacefully, by suggesting the [[House of Antilles]] and the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] join together in marriage.<ref name="Plagueis" />
*[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] is elected as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Alderaan sector/Legends|sector]] and begins service in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Plagueis" />
*The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] stops the [[Black Heth]] from starting a war on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SW:OW">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref>
*The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[First mission to Obredaan|investigate]] the [[Jin'ha]] warriors and their [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] mine.<ref name="SW:OW" />
*The Trade Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invades]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. ('''ReSynchronization Date 3:4:14''')<ref name="Blog-holocron|13/comments">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref>
**[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi attempt to negotiate the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] to cancel the invasion, but their attempts are [[Mission to Naboo|thwarted]], and they are forced to descend to the surface. After visiting both [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] and [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], they are forced to evacuate the planet.<ref name="TPM" />
**Anakin Skywalker is freed from [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] after winning the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on Tatooine.<ref name="TPM" />
**[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] attempts to capture [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in her departure from Tatooine, but is [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|thwarted]] by Qui-Gon's duel. Shortly after, Qui-Gon escaped with the Queen and the rest of the group aboard the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|Naboo Royal Cruiser]].<ref name="TPM" />
*The Jedi learn that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] are still active.<ref name="TPM" />
*The [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|Galactic Republic Chancery election]]: replaces [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] with [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="TPM" />
*Darth Sidious murders his master [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].<ref name="Plagueis" />
*[[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]] replaces Palpatine as the Senator of Naboo's [[Chommell sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Plagueis" />
*[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] is made a [[General/Legends|General]] by [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]].<ref name="TPM" />
*The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Battle of the Sacred Place|form an alliance]] with the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and implement their plan to retake Naboo from the Trade Federation.<ref name="TPM" />
*[[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]] composes the "[[Symponik Nabooalla]]."<ref name="db">{{DB|character|augie|Jowil, Augara "Augie"}}</ref>
*The [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']] is [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|destroyed]] by Anakin Skywalker and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], resulting in the death of [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]], his associates, and ending the Invasion of Naboo and its [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]].<ref name="TPM" />
*Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|duel]] with Darth Maul in the [[Plasma Refinery Complex]].<ref name="TPM" />
*Obi-Wan Kenobi is knighted after defeating [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Darth Maul. He takes Anakin Skywalker as his Padawan.<ref name="TPM" />
*Darth Maul is left for dead and escapes Naboo, eventually arriving in [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] for an exile of [[20 BBY/Legends|twelve years]].<ref name="Wrath">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>
*Qui-Gon Jinn is [[Jedi funeral/Legends|cremated]] at his [[Funeral/Legends|Funeral]] at the [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|outskirts]] of Theed on Naboo.<ref name="TPM" />
*A peace celebration takes place on Naboo's capital of Theed between the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="TPM" />
*[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] leaves the Jedi Order, as a consequence of the death of his former apprentice Qui-Gon Jinn and due to his growing disenchantment with the Jedi way. He becomes [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]' next Sith apprentice, Darth Tyranus.<ref name="NEC 2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Gardulla the Elder's criminal empire|Gardulla the Hutt's criminal empire]] falls, allowing [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire]] to take full control of Tatooine.<ref name="BH" />
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] hires the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to build a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army for the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TEA71">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[The Hunt]]: Jango Fett defeats [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]] and [[Komari Vosa]], becoming the [[Clone template/Legends|clone template]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="BH" />
*[[Nejaa Halcyon]] and [[Rostek Horn]] begin their partnership.<ref name="X-Wing">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
*[[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] becomes [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]].<ref name="Insider87Order66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|205|Drallig, Cin}}</ref>
